quote: In this paper, to avoid the shortage of serial prediction and tackle the aforementioned challenges in DEE, we propose an end-to-end model, named Document-to-Events via Parallel Prediction Networks (DE-PPN). DE-PPN is based on an encoder-decoder framework that can extract structured events from a whole document in a parallel manner.

for each predicted event, the most similar groundtruth is selected without replacement to calculate the Precision (P), Recall (R), and F1-measure (F1score). As an event type often includes multiple roles, micro-averaged role-level scores are calculated as the final DEE metric.
